raw_segments.text: He listened to her licking lap.
Ham and eggs, no, no good eggs with this dreuth, want pure fresh water.
Thursday, not a good day either for a mutton kidney at Buckley's.
Fried with butter, a shake of pepper.
Better a pork kidney at delugacs's, while the kettle is boiling.
She lapped slower than licking the saucer clean.
Why are their tongues so rough?
To lap better, all porous holes.
